name: ai-consultant-copilot
description: Workspace root for both deployable builds. `shared/` is a folder of TypeScript sources with no package.json of its own, so its single external dependency — zod — is declared here, which is where Node and TypeScript actually look when resolving a bare specifier from shared/*.ts. Both `server/` and `client/` import shared/, so both have to be installed from this root: one lockfile, one hoisted zod, one type identity.

scripts.build:server: npm run prisma:generate -w server && npm run build -w server
